stages.title: 01 / Story first
stages.summary: Finish all five chapters and the final mission to establish the story baseline. These 12 story trophies are hidden until earned; the final mission also closes the main narrative.

stages.title: 02 / Side missions and strangers
stages.summary: Work through Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, then complete eight stranger strands. Recheck the map as story progress opens new strand steps.

stages.title: 03 / Collectibles and counts
stages.summary: Build steady progress toward 100 WAiNK It locations, 100 vehicles, three card sets, 18 meditation spots and 50 challenges and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation early; it is the reported missable.

stages.title: 04 / Combat and robberies
stages.summary: Finish the 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, five bank vaults, armored truck, unseen jewelry robbery, one illegal operation per gang and Combat Focus takedowns.

stages.title: 05 / Cleanup and 100%
stages.summary: Use the in-game 35-task checklist to finish A Long Road, then earn the Platinum by completing the remaining list items. Check activity, exploration and hidden moments before closing out.

missables.title: Missable warning: Positive Mental Attitude
missables.text: Meditate at all 18 spots. Lucia’s balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1; do it early. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and before the final mission. The game has no mission replay or New Game Plus. Cheats disable trophies and saving.
